description: Automerges every update once all of its checks pass. Renovate merges it itself (platformAutomerge off) because main has no required checks, so GitHub's auto-merge would not wait for them. A merge to main deploys to production. Security fixes from vulnerability alerts skip the schedule and the 3-day release age, as Renovate does by default.

packageRules.description: Hold eslint on v9: eslint-config-next (vendored Babel parser + eslint-plugin-react@7.37.5) isn't ESLint-10-ready, so `eslint .` crashes. Tracked at https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/91702; create-harper holds its Next.js templates the same way. Drop once eslint-config-next ships past it.
